time.today: A moment earlier today, in lists of what happened. {time} is the time of day, already formatted for the language (15:25).
time.yesterday: A moment yesterday. {time} as in time.today.
time.dayAt: A moment on an earlier day. {day} is the day and month, already formatted for the language (Nov 20); {time} the time of day.
time.range: A span of days, as on a chart of weeks. {from} and {to} are days formatted as in time.dayAt.
deadline.over: A posting's application deadline has passed. Shown in a small badge next to the posting.
deadline.todayAt: The deadline is later today. {time} is when (23:59). Small badge.
deadline.tomorrow: The deadline is tomorrow (by the calendar, however few hours away). Small badge.
deadline.daysLeft: Days until the deadline, by the calendar; {n} is 2 or more. Plural forms separated by |, in the order of the language's plural categories (one | other for English). Small badge.
todos.deadline.past: On a to-do card about something with a deadline (an assessment, a reply): its deadline has passed.
todos.deadline.today: On a to-do card: its deadline is today.
todos.deadline.left: On a to-do card: days until its deadline; {n} is 1 or more. Plural forms as in deadline.daysLeft.
language.beta: In the language picker, next to a language whose translation is not complete yet. {name} is the language's own name.
analytics.change.same: Under a figure on the analytics page: it is the same as in the period of the same length before.
analytics.change.diff: Under a figure on the analytics page: how it changed against the period of the same length before. {change} is a signed percentage, already formatted (+20%, -15%).
todos.due.past: On a to-do card, after its due date (an interview, an assessment): the date has passed. Lower case: it follows the date after a dot (Nov 20 · overdue).
todos.due.today: On a to-do card, after its due date: it is today. Lower case, as todos.due.past.
calendar.nav: Sidebar entry of the calendar page.
calendar.title: Title of the calendar page.
calendar.sub: Line under the title of the calendar page.
calendar.add: Button: add an item of the applicant's own on a day.
calendar.addOn: Accessible name of the small + button under a day in the week view. {day} is a formatted date.
calendar.prev: Accessible name of the left-arrow button: the previous month, week or day.
calendar.next: Accessible name of the right-arrow button.
calendar.kind.deadline: Filter chip and item label: a posting's application deadline.
calendar.kind.assessment: Filter chip and item label: an online assessment or test to finish by a date.
calendar.kind.offer: Filter chip and item label: the date by which to answer an offer.
calendar.kind.info_request: Filter chip and item label: an employer asked for something to be sent by a date.
calendar.kind.contact: Filter chip and item label: a contact the applicant wanted to follow up with on that day.
calendar.kind.own: Filter chip and item label: an item the applicant added themselves.
calendar.kind.snoozed: Filter chip and item label: a to-do card put off until that time.
calendar.kind.sent: Filter chip and item label: an application went out at that time (to look back).
calendar.kind.reply: Filter chip and item label: an employer's mail arrived.
calendar.kind.task: Filter chip and item label: the program's own work waiting for its time.
calendar.state.label: Accessible name of the filter select.
calendar.state.any: First option of the state filter.
calendar.state.progressed: State filter option: assessment, interview or offer.
calendar.company: Placeholder of the company search box.
calendar.minScore: Filter label before a number (for deadlines).
calendar.allDeadlines: Filter checkbox: also deadlines of postings already applied for, set aside or offline.
calendar.deadlines: Badge in a month cell: how many posting deadlines fall on that day.
calendar.more: In a month cell, under the first three items.
calendar.allDay: In place of a time, for an item that has a day but no time.
calendar.timeline: Card title in the day view: the items with a time, in order.
calendar.nothingTimed: Empty state of the timeline card.
calendar.list: Card title in the day view: all items, most pressing first.
calendar.nothing: Empty state of the day list.
calendar.open: Button opening an item's link (the meeting of an interview, the start of an assessment).
calendar.linkAdd: Button: give the item a link (the meeting, the assessment).
calendar.start: Button on a deadline of a posting not applied for.
calendar.notApplying: Button on a deadline: mark the posting as one not applied for.
calendar.doneMsg: Short message after marking an item done.
calendar.movedMsg: Short message after changing an item's date.
calendar.started: Short message after Start an application.
calendar.added: Short message after adding an item.
calendar.form.title: Label of the text field of a new item.
calendar.form.titleHint: Example placeholder for a new item's text. Use a company name that is clearly made up.
calendar.form.link: Label: a link the item leads to (optional).
analytics.first.title: Title of a card on the analytics page (job search results): time from a posting to the first record of its application that is ready to be sent.
analytics.first.explain: Help text behind the (i) of the card analytics.first.title.
analytics.first.sub: Under the title analytics.first.title: how many applications the figures are about.
analytics.first.fromFound: Label under a big figure (a duration).
analytics.first.fromBegun: Label under a big figure (a duration).
analytics.first.slow: Small line under analytics.first.fromFound: how many applications waited more than three days from finding to the first record. Plural forms as usual.
analytics.backlog.title: Title of a card on the analytics page: how long the cards on the to-do page wait before they are dealt with.
analytics.backlog.explain: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.backlog.title.
analytics.backlog.kind: Table column: the kind of to-do card (answer a question, approve a record, sign in…).
analytics.backlog.handled: Table column: how many cards of that kind were dealt with.
analytics.backlog.median: Table column: median time those cards waited.
analytics.backlog.oldest: Small heading over a list of the oldest open to-do cards, each with how long it has waited.
analytics.missed.why: Before a row of tags that count why good postings were missed (analytics.missed.reason.*).
analytics.missed.due: Under a missed posting: its deadline. {day} is a formatted date.
analytics.missed.reason.no_link: Why a good posting was not applied for before its deadline: the posting had no link to apply at. Lower case, a tag.
analytics.missed.reason.not_started: Why a good posting was missed: no application was begun for it.
analytics.missed.reason.waited_for_you: Why a good posting was missed: its application waited for the applicant (an answer, an approval, a sign-in).
analytics.missed.reason.failed: Why a good posting was missed: its application failed.
analytics.missed.reason.under_way: Why a good posting was missed: its application was still being worked when the deadline passed.
analytics.missed.reason.withdrawn: Why a good posting was missed: the applicant withdrew the application.
analytics.asked.title: Title of a card on the analytics page (automation): form questions the applicant had to answer in several applications.
analytics.asked.explain: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.asked.title.
analytics.asked.question: Table column.
analytics.asked.times: Table column: in how many applications it was asked.
analytics.asked.remember: Button in a row: saves the question with the answer into the applicant's profile as a standard answer.
analytics.asked.inProfile: Tag in a row instead of the button analytics.asked.remember: the profile already has this answer.
analytics.unknown.title: Title of a card on the analytics page (automation): applications where Submit was pressed but it was not seen whether they went out.
analytics.unknown.explain: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.unknown.title.
analytics.unknown.median: Label under a big figure (a duration).
analytics.unknown.open: Label under a big figure (a count), followed by the oldest of them with how long they have waited.
calendar.alarm.title: Heading in an item's side panel: the reminders of this item.
calendar.alarm.sameDay: A reminder of a whole-day item on the day itself, at the morning hour set in the settings.
calendar.alarm.days: A reminder this many days before. For a whole-day item: in the morning of that day.
calendar.alarm.hours: A reminder this many hours before.
calendar.alarm.minutes: A reminder this many minutes before. {n} may be 0: at the time itself.
calendar.alarm.add: Button after a number of minutes typed by hand.
calendar.alarm.remove: Accessible name of the × on a reminder.
calendar.alarm.customLabel: Accessible name of the number field for a reminder of one's own.
calendar.alarm.hint: Hint under the reminders of an item with a time.
calendar.alarm.hintAllDay: Hint under the reminders of a whole-day item.
calendar.share.button: Button in the calendar page head.
calendar.share.title: Title of the panel.
calendar.share.localOnly: Hint when the program's address is localhost.
calendar.share.reachable: Hint when the program has an address other devices can reach.
calendar.share.renew: Button: replaces the address; the old one stops working.
calendar.rang.title: Heading at the top of the to-do page: the calendar reminders that went off in the last hours.
calendar.rang.openDay: Button: open that day on the calendar.
settings.reminders.title: Settings section title.
settings.reminders.none: Placeholder and text when a kind gets no reminder by itself.
settings.reminders.quiet: Checkbox. Off by default: a reminder you set goes out at its time.
files.kind.made: Kind of file in the material library: a PDF the agent put together from the applicant's own files for one application (several in a row, some pages).
files.purpose.label: Label before the purpose of a file in its panel.
files.purpose.mine: Purpose of a file the applicant uploaded.
files.purpose.forJob: Purpose of a cover letter or tailored résumé.
files.madeFrom: Label before the list of files and pages a put-together file holds.
files.belongs: Label before the application the file was made for (a link), followed by its state.
files.ended: Tag after an application's state: it is over (rejected, withdrawn, the posting gone, or sent long ago).
files.went: Label before the list of applications and mails the file went with.
files.how.sent: Tag: the file went out with that application (uploaded to the form).
files.how.record: Tag: the record of an application not sent yet names the file.
files.how.mail: Tag: the file was attached to a mail the program sent.
files.filter.archived: Filter checkbox; {n} is how many are archived.
files.archivedBadge: Badge on a file in the list.
files.sentBadge: Badge on a file that went out with an application.
files.archive: Button: put the file away from the everyday list (it is kept).
files.clean: Button at the foot of the folder list: files made for applications that are over, which nothing in progress uses.
files.deletedKept: Short message after deleting several files.
calendar.links.fromMail: In an item's side panel, above the links found in the employer's mail when there are several (the program does not guess which one is the meeting).
calendar.links.use: Button next to one of those links: make it the item's link.
